summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a 6-K reporting minutes of its 63rd Extraordinary Shareholders' Meeting held on July 31, 2026, where shareholders approved the merger of Fibrasil Infraestrutura e Fibra Óptica S.A. into the Company, effective August 1, 2026. The meeting ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers as the appraisal firm for the merger. No financial terms, share prices, or premiums were disclosed. The merger is a vertical integration of fiber infrastructure assets, likely simplifying corporate structure. Watch for regulatory approvals and any minority shareholder dissent rights.
